S.I.N. #2

Cu o condiție

K. Bromberg, Maria Dosei (Translator)

4.07
7,087 ratings633 reviews
Rate this book
Cerința este absurdă, dar simplă: trebuie să rămân două luni în Cedar Falls și să dau curs solicitării primarului acestui oraș de a mă ocupa de deschiderea The Retreat, cel mai nou complex al companiei Sharpe International Network, pe care o conduc alături de cei doi frați ai mei.

Am o istorie cu acest mic oraș din Montana, o poveste pe care am încercat, dar nu am reușit niciodată s-o uit. Asher Wells. Fata mea din câmpurile de lavandă.

Visa să plece din Cedar Falls și să-și facă un nume. De ce este încă aici, în fața mea? Și, mai important, de ce mă privește cu durere în ochi, când eu sunt cel care a fost obligat să plece pentru a evita consecințele acelei nopți?

Am tot ce îmi doresc: bani, succes, un imperiu de condus... totul, cu o singură excepție: ea.

Cincisprezece ani sunt mult timp pentru a te întreba... ce ar fi fost dacă. De data aceasta, n-am să mai plec din acest oraș fără ea.

About the author

K. Bromberg

114 books19.6k followers
New York Times Bestselling author K. Bromberg writes contemporary romance novels that make you work to get your happily ever after. She likes to write strong heroines and damaged heroes, who we love to hate but can’t help but love.

Since publishing her first book on a whim in 2013, Kristy has sold over two million copies of her books across twenty different countries and has landed on the New York Times, USA Today, and Wall Street Journal Bestsellers lists over thirty times.

A mom of three, Kristy finds the only thing harder than finishing the book she’s writing is navigating parenthood during the teenage years (send more wine!). She loves dogs, sports, a good book, and is an expert procrastinator. She lives in Southern California with her family.

4 STARS
Her anger is bitter. Her desire is sweet. Both riot against my tongue as my head swims with the taste of Asher Wells.

I live for a good second chance romance, and I've been eagerly anticipating this one for months. I loved the first book in this series and if you haven't read that yet, I highly recommend you do. Though you could easily read this one as a standalone, it's so much better when you get the different dynamics that is the Sharpe triplets. They may look the same, but they have their own sharp edges that were molded in their own different and unique relationship with their father. Callahan offered one view, but Ledger brings a completely different one.

Ledger ran from the small town of Cedar Falls years ago, but he never forgot the girl he fell hard and fast for. Now a business opportunity forces him back to the town he couldn't run faster from and face to face with the woman he would have thought would be long gone. Now admittedly, I spent half the book waiting for the other shoe to drop to the usual cliche small town second chance scenario. I'm happy to say this book wasn't that. Ledger and Asher have history, but they each have a very different recollection of it. As they're both forced to spend time together, they soon realize how different their version is from the other.

Ledger is eager to get to know this grown up Asher, while Asher is much more hesitant to open the door back to the man who once shattered her heart. I loved their slow burn rekindling, though I did find it a bit slow paced in parts.

This was a steamy and sweet second chance romance, low on the angst but with plenty of feels, and it hit all the spots. I simply adore this series and can't wait for the next one!

Ledger Sharpe is the firstborn of identical triplets that grew up as part of New York City’s elite. He’s a successful businessman who runs Sharpe International with his two brothers. He’s ridiculously wealthy, a planner, loves negotiating and likes to be in control. He has high standards, and when he sets goals he meets them. His family has made a name for themselves in the hospitality industry, and their newest project is an old hotel they are transforming into a resort. The only problem is this small Montana town isn’t interested in their big city mentality and have decided to give them a hard time. He will have to spend two months there and jump through hoops before they can proceed with opening their resort. He swore he’d never step foot in Cedar Falls again, and now he’s stuck there having to revisit the past. He hasn’t seen Asher Wells since he was a teenager and he’s never forgotten her. As their attraction is reawakened there’s a new desire to get to know the woman she’s become. Is it too late, or will he get a second chance at love?

Asher Wells has lived on a farm in the same small town her whole life. The lavender fields were her legacy and had been in her family for generations. She’s trying to make ends meet and map out her future when the boy who once said he’d love her forever returns to town. Ledger Sharpe made her feel special, and then he left without a word. It’s been fifteen years, and their connection is still strong, but she’s not interested in a walk down memory lane. They come from completely different worlds, and she can’t take another heartbreak, but she also can’t deny their chemistry and how he still affects her. Will they get attached again or walk away?



On One Condition by K. Bromberg is the second book in the S.I.N. series. It’s a standalone, small town, billionaire romance about family, first loves, and second chances. Opposites attract and we get a beautiful love story with all the feels! I adore this series and can’t wait for more!!! <333

This is a beautifully written second chance love story. I teared up about Asher’s troubled past. Then when the lies are reveled from Ledger and Asher’s teen years that tore them apart, my heart caught in my throat. Asher is a strong, determined woman dealing with so much heartache - I just loved her. And. She has a terrific best friend which I always love to see - Nita is always there to set Asher straight, support her, and just be there with wine.

A favorite part? When 8 year old Tootie meets Ledger:
“I’m Tootie.” “Tootie?”“Yep. It’s short for Trudy because who names a kid Trudy these days? So I made up my own version of it that suits me better.” I feel like I’m talking to a thirty-year-old with her matter-of-fact statements, but that little giggle she gives reaffirms I’m not. Tootie rocks. I loved all the Tootie banter!

I melted when Ledger said “You are Asher Wells, my lavender girl, and maker of her own destiny”. I cheered when Asher found her strength and her own new dreams and went for it and when Ledger spoils her beyond those dreams, I couldn’t stop smiling. But when Ledger finally, yes finally admits his true feelings? I was dead. Ended. Big fat tears at the end of this one.

In other words, this book is an emotional read and will definitely get to you. A second chance at love that’s so heartwarming, sometimes heartbreaking, and has so many feels, you won’t want to put it down.

If you love second chance romances, then dive right into On One Condition by K. Bromberg. This is book two in the S.I.N. series, but can easily be read as a standalone. It’s about three identical triplet brothers who grew up wealthy with all the perks including guidance from their father in how to succeed in business. The father passed away recently, and the three Sharpe brothers continue his legacy and are at the top of their game building luxury, high-end resorts.

In book one, The Last Resort, Callahan meets his now wife, Sutton, when the former playboy and more slacker of a brother was sent to one of their properties in the Virgin Islands with the directive to fix the problems or he’s out of the family business. Of course he does a bang up job and gets the girl, and now it’s his brother, Ledger’s turn to fall.

As teens, the three brothers summered in Cedar Falls, Montana, and it is during that time that Ledger met Asher Wells, our sweet small-town girl with a big heart and even bigger dreams. For three summers they were young lovers until something unexpected happens and they never see each other again. Both were left bewildered and heartbroken, never to speak again until 15 years later.

The author drew me in from the very beginning and I loved their entire journey from the first page to the last. I truly believe what happens in your past shapes who you are as adults, and Ledger never forgot the one who got away. I am a sucker for small-town romance, and Asher never saw him or judged him as the son of billionaire. Their pull is instant and while they are hesitant, they can’t help but want to get to know one another again, and finally get the closure and answers they need.

I admired her trying to keep a distance and his persistence in trying. The story is artfully told with flashbacks into the past in dual points of view, and it was really beautiful to read how they openly communicated and moved forward with forgiveness and hope, even after learning the devastating truth of what tore them apart.

Ledger is only in town for two months to follow-up on the final phase of their latest resort, which gives them plenty of time for long walks in the lavender fields that her family owned and was recently passed down to her. But he’s not staying and she knows she can’t survive her heart being shattered for the second time, but they can't deny their feelings. Their lives are so vastly different, yet when they are together, nothing else matters.

Asher was strong, beautiful and resilient. Rejected by the town because of her mother’s actions, she held her head high even when she was deeply hurting. I loved her passion and growth and how she never expected or asked anything of Ledger. I loved her drive and loyalty to her grandparents who raised her, and her vision and perseverance for her family business, The Fields, that desperately needs to turn a profit.

Ledger was a planner. He was smart and rigid and really had no life outside of work and his time with his brothers. He was the city boy, had the best education, and was raised to be focused and goal oriented. Asher bought a softness to him. He slowed down, was more relaxed and completely content with her by his side. There are sweet dates, a big romantic gesture, and all kinds of steamy sexy times as these two reconnect and they realize no one else in their 15 years apart could ever compare. Their connection never faded or lost its spark. She loved him for him, not the billionaire businessman, but the man standing before her in the lavender fields.

These two did not have it easy and the author will take you on their journey as they reveal secrets that only bring them closer. I loved how they worked through the past and how even though their lives were so vastly different now, that they were able to work it out. Love the meaning of “On One Condition”–that you’ll love me forever.

Asher had her guard up through most of the book–her mother, teen Ledger, and pretty much the entire town rejected her. It was emotional to read how she had been beaten down by life, but our girl doesn’t compromise her values and finally gets her own HEA with an epilogue that had me smiling from ear to ear. You will be routing for her the entire time and wishing you could be her friend in real life. I love a fierce heroine who isn’t pretentious, isn’t afraid of hard work, and wants to make it on her own.

I loved Ledger’s relationship with his brothers and all their witty banter and support of one another. I highly recommend The Last Resort featuring Callahan and Sutton, On One Condition featuring Ledger and Asher, and Final Proposal coming soon, featuring Ford, the last brother to fall.

On One Condition is the second book in the S.I.N. series about three triplets—Callahan, Ledger and Ford Sharpe. This is Ledger’s story. He and his brothers want to develop a resort in the town of Cedar Falls, Montana—a town where they used to visit as teenagers during the summer. It’s a town that Ledger doesn’t want to return to as he had heartbreak there with a girl, Asher, that he was in love with. The mayor of the town is requiring one of the Sharpe brothers to live there for two months if they want their permits.

Ledger is the chosen brother. Who does he run into on his first day? Asher. The girl from the wrong side of the tracks. The girl who was raised by her grandparents as her parents didn’t want her. The girl who the other townspeople look down on.

This is a wonderful second chance steamy romance. Of course, there is miscommunication of what happened between them when they were teenagers. I like that they did speak about it and learn each other’s side of what happened.

I really enjoy this author’s writing. Her characters are always so fleshed out and real. In this story, both the main characters are in their early thirties, which is always refreshing to have a bit more maturity and life under their belts.

Thank you to Valentine PR and the author for my advanced readers copy. All thoughts and opinions are my own.

These triplets definitely all have a story to tell and we already heard Callahan's in The Last Resort and now we have heard Ledger's in On One Condition. Ledger is the oldest from the triplets and his father has been the hardest on him because he feels like he needs to depend on him the most and he needs to condition him to be nothing but the best because Ledger is going to be the head of the company and lead his brothers one day.

When they were younger his father would take them down to Cedar Falls for the summer and they would just go and enjoy their youth out there while his father conducted business and well Ledger met Asher Wells and he fell in love with her the minute he laid eyes on her. She always lived a harsh life around the towns people because they were always cruel to her. She was raised by her grandparents and once she grew up and wanted to go to college in NY she wanted to aspire in becoming an artist but her dream quickly got shut down when she was called back by her grandfather over her grandmother falling ill.

Asher and Ledger did not end up doing what they wanted as teenagers all because of his father and his harshness. She wasn't of their social status and he wanted nothing but the finest for his sons. He went to Asher's grandparents house to tell her that she was not allowed to ever see his son again and he came through with his promise. He told his son nothing but lies about Asher just like he did with Asher about his son.



A decade or so later he goes back to Cedar Falls about constructing a luxury hotel and he runs into Asher and he wants nothing but to explain to her how things went down all those years ago but she wants to hear nothing of it. At first she gives him a hard time, but little by little Ledger starts wearing her down. And little by little their chemistry starts to reignite and their friendship/romance starts to bloom again. Can they make it work this time around or will also be a fleeting romance?

I really enjoyed the chemistry between Ledger and Asher. For two young kids to have harbored feelings for each other for so long and even though they thought that there were no more feelings after so long, but once they saw each other again, the butterflies reignited. That just made me get butterflies for them.

K. Bromberg has a way with her words and I can't wait for the Final Proposal (Ford's story)!!

I absolutely inhaled this story in one darn sitting!

5 Stars

Ok so I loved and adored the Last Resort, the first instalment in the S.I.N. series following Callahan and Sutton. But let me tell you, Ledger Sharpe and Asher Wells came in and stole the show.

I thought I couldn’t love a Sharpe brother more than I loved Callahan and then I met Ledger. The eldest of the triplets, the one most hard done by, from his fathers lies and secrets and then just how much these said secrets and lies affected Asher.

TALK ABOUT SECOND CHANCE… This book is 16 years after the initially were together. And boy were those flashback chapters ones to love and adore. Watching Asher and Ledger fall in love not once but twice was beautiful, powerful and breathtaking. And this book truly had everything I crave in romance. It had dates. Where we saw these two grow and watch their love blossom. Talk about the lavender fields, holy shit…. Talk about spicy scenes, that definitely hits the favourites list. The picnic before hand, it was so sweet from Ledge. Hard rough exterior businessman goes soft the girl he’s been in love with for the past 16 years.

Everything about Ledge and Ash made me smile, swoon and sweat.

Especially their On One Condition, you’ll love me forever.

It was perfect in every sense of the word. And I’m desperate for Ford’s book. Totally see him in a single parent trope somehow. Especially after seeing Tootie and Ledger.

K. Bromberg knows how to right amazing, epic romance and this book was one of them. It’s a perfect second chance, small town romance feel with lots of spice, feels and love. I crave a solid epilogue for these books with Callahan and Sutton with their daughter, Asher and Ledger and any kiddos they have and Ford and …. as well.

November 25, 2024
A fost prima întâlnire cu scrierea lui K. Bromberg și nu sunt sigură dacă am făcut alegerea bună sau nu 🫣.

Primul volum, “Fără regrete”, vine cu one night stand, under one roof, billionaire romance, forced proximity, forbidden love, steamy scenes, dual POV.

“Ce ar putea să meargă prost atunci ești obligată să lucrezi și să trăiești alături de un bărbat căruia nu-i poți rezista?”

Sutton prinde oportunitatea de a se afirma la job și este inclusă într-un proiect alături de bărbatul cu care a avut o aventură de-o noapte. Ea încearcă să se limiteze la o relație strict profesională, însă Callahan este de o cu totul altă părere.

Și aici vine frustrarea mea… Callahan mi s-a părut un fustangiu, arogant peste măsură și nu mi-a plăcut absolut deloc de el. Sutton mi-a lăsat impresia că este o femeie hotărâtă, mai ales după decizia luată de a se despărți de iubitul care o abuza emoțional, dar se pare că m-a indus în eroare. Se contrazicea în alegeri și gânduri, dorindu-mi pentru ea să rămână la fel de determinată ca la început, nu să cedeze atât de ușor.

Al doilea volum, “Cu o condiție”, cuprinde second chance romance, small town lavender farmer, billionaire romance, the one that got away, dual POV.

“Am o istorie cu acest mic oraș din Montana, o poveste pe care am încercat, dar nu am reușit niciodată să o uit. Asher Wells. Fata mea din câmpurile de lavandă.”

Spre deosebire de primul volum, acesta chiar mi-a plăcut și am îndrăgit personajele, în special pe Asher, deși nici cu Ledger nu mi-a fost rușine.
Mi-au plăcut micile trimiteri în trecut, la începuturile lor, cum s-au cunoscut și cum a evoluat relația dintre ei, sentimentele lor și jocul murdar în care au fost prinși, cum acesta le-a afectat relația, dar în ciuda tuturor piedicilor, sentimentele nu s-au stins în totalitate.
Nu pot să spun că-s mare fană a trope-ului second chance, dar aici mi-a plăcut cum a fost executat, că nu a fost nimic grăbit, din contră, a curs lin și a lăsat loc de “digerare”, iar Asher a fost genul de femeie care nu se lasă cu una cu două.

5 SMOOCHES!

I seriously love second-chance romances, especially when they’re a second chance at first love. On One Condition, the second book in K. Bromberg’s S.I.N. Series, is Asher and Ledger’s story. Kristy’s addictive storytelling is on full display in this emotionally charged, heart-tugging love story.

Through the use flashbacks, Bromberg takes readers back in time to Asher and Ledger’s youthful romance and intermingles them with the present. Their rich backstory was a bittersweet romance that ended in misunderstandings and without closure. I loved Asher, she was such a strong heroine, and she’s sacrificed so much. Ridiculously handsome and as charming as ever, Ledger was the cool and collected, totally in-control executive—except when Asher was nearby. The chemistry between them is still there, bubbling between them, but it was the unresolved emotion and the love they still had for each other that spoke to my heart. Kristy weaved a bit of a suspenseful edge into the story that made it an absolutely irresistible page-turner.

On One Condition was an unputdownable second-chance at first love romance full of heart, heat and healing. I practically inhaled this story in a single sitting with a huge smile on my face and full, happy heart – especially after that epilogue! Five smooches from me for On One Condition by K. Bromberg!
~Danielle Palumbo

The second book in the S.I.N. Series brought the emotions and then-some. I honestly didn’t expect to be hit with all these feelings. Ledger and Asher were something else and boy did they make me feel.

Asher was strong, independent, fiery, and determined. She has big dreams and is striving to reach them. She has a big and caring heart and I just adored her.

Ledger is every bit of the successful man. His next assignment takes him back to the small town of Cedar Falls where there’s more than a handful of memories, especially the ones of falling in love and how it ended.

Asher and Ledger were everything to each other as teenagers. It’s the quintessential story of the rich boy and small town girl who fall for each other only for it to crumble in the end. We get flashbacks of their past relationship and see how it started and ultimately how it ended. Now, more than a decade later and with Ledger back in Cedar Falls overseeing a project and where Asher still lives, they cross paths after so many years and it’s evident that their connection is still there. After everything that’s happened is it enough though, can they have a second chance at happiness, and can Asher and Ledger reconnect and find and fall in love again?

On One Condition was an amazing second chance romance. Asher and Ledger’s story was a whirlwind of emotions. A great addition to the series and I can’t wait for the next book.

*Thank you Valentine PR for the ARC*

On One Condition by K. Bromberg was a sweet, seductive, and emotional second chance small town billionaire romance that was just what my heart needed. Ledger and Asher have a one of a kind love that started long ago during summer visits to Cedar Falls when they were teenagers that abruptly ended in heartbreak. Fifteen years later, and all grown up, Ledger and Asher are given a second chance to clear up misconceptions of the past and fall in love all over again

This audiobook is narrated by Muffy Newtown and J.F. Harding. This was the first time I’d heard them paired together, and they were amazing as Asher and Ledger. In Muffy’s performance you could feel Asher’s pain, confidence, desires, and new found passion to stand on her own and make her family proud. J.F. was spot on portraying Ledger’s conflicted, determined, and swoony persona as he as came to terms with his past and figured out his true feelings for Asher! Plus, the chemistry and the undeniable connection between Asher and Ledger was absolute fire, and you could feel all of this and more in their performances.

Overall I loved this audiobook! If you are a fan of a small town second chance romance with a hot hunky billionaire moonlight boy, a fierce brave lavender girl, Cedar Falls, resorts, teenage love, a meddling father, farm life, town hall meetings, super hot steamy times, (hello bathroom spice!) joining the mile high club in a private jet, heartfelt conversations, and a HEA that will leave your heart in only one condition, deliciously happy, then you will love Ledger and Asher’s story. I am loving Bromberg’s S.I.N. series and am looking forward to Ford’s romance next!
